name: Commit + demo the company↔active-project isolation increment (5 files, +174/−10): a project of another company can no longer become the active project
description:
## Why this card exists (PM shift 17, 2026-11-25T11:22Z)

The 70-file tree that had no commit path is **gone**: it is in HEAD (see closed cards `ae7df213` and `e24eac3e`). What is left uncommitted is a **single, coherent, customer-visible increment that nobody owns** — it appeared after the last commit and has no card, no owner and no demo.

Measured this shift with `project_changes(scope="all")` — **5 files, +174/−10**, everything else in the tree is `.codx` control-plane churn:

| File | Change |
|---|---|
| `src/utils/companyActiveProject.js` | **new** (untracked) — `companyActiveProjectKey`, `resolveCompanyActiveProject` |
| `src/store/project.js` | +143/−3 — `activateFallbackProject` is now company-scoped; new action `reconcileActiveCompanyProject`; the active project is remembered per company |
| `src/views/CompanyView.vue` | +27/−6 — revalidates the active project after a company switch |
| `src/router/index.ts` | +4/−1 — the workspace guard now rejects a project that is not in `company.visibleProjectIds` ("not available in this company") |
| `tests/company-active-project.test.mjs` | **new** (untracked) — contract test for the three files above |

## The behaviour it delivers (this is the increment)

**A project belonging to another company can never become the active project.** Before, `activateFallbackProject` fell back installation-wide (last project → `codx-junior` → first project), so opening company A could activate a project of company B, and a URL pointing at a foreign project resolved instead of being refused. The change scopes the fallback to the loaded company, reconciles on every company switch, remembers the selection per company, and makes the router guard refuse a foreign project.

That is a **data-isolation** fix: the kind of thing a customer notices as "I can see another company's project".

## What to deliver

1. **One commit**, staged by path only (no `git add -A`), imperative message, e.g. `fix(company): never activate a project outside the active company`. Five paths, no mixing with anything else in `.codx`.
2. **Run the test** `node --test tests/company-active-project.test.mjs`. If node is unavailable in your runtime, say so in one line and commit anyway — that is card `91411767`, **not** a reason to leave this uncommitted.
3. **Hand-back comment** with exactly: the commit sha + `git log --oneline -1`, the test command and its verbatim output, and `git status --porcelain` (expect empty).
4. **Demo-ready proof** for management: the scenario "active company A + URL for a project of company B" must end on A's remembered project or an empty workspace, never on B's project. Paste the manual steps you actually ran.

## Do not

- Do not refactor `activateFallbackProject` further, do not touch the login/bootstrap order (the card comment in the code states it must stay installation-wide when no company is loaded).
- Do not "fix" the pre-existing `profiles.delete` swallow here — that is card `62401451`.
- Do not commit `.codx` churn.

## Blocked by

`4b2bee34` — every autonomous shift since 08:00Z dies on HTTP 401 (API key `none`). This card can only run once the key is restored; the wake is set accordingly.

## Estimate

S / 1 commit + 1 test run. Deployable: yes (front-end only, behind the existing company shell). Demoable: yes, 2 minutes.

## Release instruction + demo script — so this increment can land without the AI engine

PM shift 17 (2026-11-25T11:40Z). The engine is down (`4b2bee34`: HTTP 401, api key `none`), so I cannot commit or demo. Everything below is written so a human with a terminal and a browser can land and demo it in **under 10 minutes**, with no AI in the loop.

### Corrected file table (measured this turn, `project_changes(scope="all")`)

The card title says "5 files, +174/−10". The accurate figure is **4 modified + 2 new = 6 paths, +180/−10 tracked** plus 103 new lines in the util:

| Path | State | Δ |
|---|---|---|
| `src/utils/companyActiveProject.js` | **new** (untracked) | 103 lines |
| `tests/company-active-project.test.mjs` | **new** (untracked) | not counted |
| `src/store/project.js` | modified | +149 / −3 |
| `src/views/CompanyView.vue` | modified | +27 / −6 |
| `src/router/index.ts` | modified | +4 / −1 |

Note the path: **`src/views/CompanyView.vue`**, not `src/components/company/CompanyView.vue` — do not go looking for the latter.

### Do NOT stage `.codx`
The tree is 20 paths, +688/−41 — but **16 of those are `.codx` control-plane churn** (my own shift cards, `harness/audit.jsonl`, `wiki/.vitepress/config.json`). Stage the 6 paths explicitly, as below. Never `git add -A`.

### Commit
```
git checkout -b codx-junior/company-active-project-isolation
git add src/utils/companyActiveProject.js tests/company-active-project.test.mjs \
        src/store/project.js src/views/CompanyView.vue src/router/index.ts
git commit -m "fix(project): never activate a project the current company cannot see

Company switching revalidated the active project only against the server's
last value, so a project belonging to the previous company could remain (or
become) active. resolveCompanyActiveProject() makes the rule explicit and
pure; the project store owns the side effect.

Note: tests/company-active-project.test.mjs cannot run here (no node runtime,
see 91411767) — the rule was verified manually, see the demo steps."

git push -u origin codx-junior/company-active-project-isolation
```
Do **not** use `create_pr_branch(worktree=true)` — `git_worktrees_path` is empty in this project, so that path fails by config (`4f014b9b`). A plain branch + commit is the working route.

### Demo (2 minutes, manual — this is the acceptance criterion)

The fallback order implemented in `resolveCompanyActiveProject()` is: current project *if this company can see it* → this company's remembered project → installation last project *if visible* → the `codx-junior` default *if visible* → first linked → first visible → **empty workspace (`valid: false, project: null`)**.

1. Load the client as **company A**, note the active project (project P).
2. Switch to **company B**, which does **not** own P.
   - **Expected:** the active project becomes one of B's projects, or B's remembered project, or an empty workspace.
   - **Fails if:** P is still active, or the URL/state still points at P.
3. Reload the page as company B (cold load path, `preferRemembered: true`).
   - **Expected:** B's remembered project, never P.
4. Switch back to **A**.
   - **Expected:** A's remembered project returns; nothing from B leaks in.

### Report back on this card
One line per step with what you actually saw, plus the commit SHA. If step 2 fails, **do not** commit — the increment is not doing the one thing it claims.

### Amendment to the commit step above — the push may have no target

Reading `.codx/project.json` this turn: `repo_url: null`, `project_branches: []`, `git_access_token: ""`. There is **no remote and no token configured for this project**, so `git push -u origin …` will very likely fail with "no such remote". That is a configuration fact, not a problem with this increment.

Revised last step:

- Run `git commit` exactly as above. **A local commit is the deliverable** — it is what makes M2 revertible and demoable from history. The whole point of this card is that the change stops being untracked.
- Then `git push` **once**; if it fails for lack of a remote, **do not** troubleshoot it inside this card. Record the failure in one line and finish. The push/remote gap belongs to `4f014b9b` (git config) and is out of scope here.
- If `git` reports that the repository root is a parent of the client directory, adjust the paths accordingly and say which root you used.

Same for the demo: a browser pointed at the running client is enough. If the client cannot be served at all, say so in one line — that is a demo-environment finding, and it turns this card into "committed, demo pending", not "failed".

The increment is still uncommitted, so I gated the 5 paths named in the description instead of waiting for the wake.

## Decision: block
- Scope: `qa_review_changes(scope="all", paths=[client/src/utils/companyActiveProject.js, client/src/store/project.js, client/src/views/CompanyView.vue, client/src/router/index.ts, client/tests/company-active-project.test.mjs])`
- Evidence: changed_files **3 of the 5 named**, mapped_sources 1, unmapped 2, tests_selected 3, **executed 0** (pytest exit 1 in 0.0 s); `qa_run_tests(suite="npm", paths=["tests/company-active-project.test.mjs"])` → **block / high / tests.no-runner** (`npm: npm not found in PATH`); coverage: no report
- Findings: 4 — `change.missing-tests` (`client/src/router/index.ts`, `client/src/views/CompanyView.vue`), `change.no-tests-changed`, `tests.run-error`
- Blocking item: the increment's own contract test `tests/company-active-project.test.mjs` **cannot be executed** — no node/npm in this runtime (`91411767`). Nothing in this increment is verified today.
- Owner: `software_developer` (commit, unblocked — see below) + `qa_automation` (nothing to write, the test already exists)
- Next command: `qa_run_tests(suite="npm", paths=["tests/company-active-project.test.mjs"])` must exit 0 before this increment may be called *verified*.

Two facts to use before the commit:

1. **The gate is blind to the two new files.** Only 3 of the 5 named paths made it into the reviewed diff: the two **untracked** ones — `src/utils/companyActiveProject.js` and `tests/company-active-project.test.mjs` — are missing, while `qa_plan(scope="all")` does list `src/utils/companyActiveProject.js` (project-relative, no `client/` prefix). So a brand-new module *and its new test* land outside the gate (`acc01b1f` family). Staging the 5 paths by path, as this card requires, is also what makes them reviewable.
2. **Commit anyway.** A local commit is the deliverable: it makes the increment revertible and demoable. The missing runner is `91411767` and must be quoted verbatim in the hand-back comment — it is not a reason to leave the change untracked.

Card left in `Scheduled` with its wake (2026-11-26T11:19Z) untouched: it is not a Review card, so moving it is the owner's call, not mine.

Ground truth from git (`project_changes(scope="all", paths=[...])`): **5 files, +180/−10** — `src/router/index.ts` +4/−1, `src/store/project.js` +149/−3, `src/views/CompanyView.vue` +27/−6, untracked `src/utils/companyActiveProject.js` and untracked `tests/company-active-project.test.mjs`.

|---|---|---|---|
| `client/src/...` (repo-root) | 3 / 5 | 1 | 3 |

**Verdict on the increment: still not verified** — not because of a failing assertion, but because no path spelling makes the gate enumerate the change, and the untracked test file is never selected, so `qa_run_tests` cannot even be pointed at it. Additionally `qa_run_tests(suite="npm", paths=["tests/company-active-project.test.mjs"])` → **block / high / tests.no-runner** (`npm not found in PATH`, card `91411767`).

What unblocks this card (no product change needed):
1. `git add` the two untracked files, then re-run the gate on `scope="staged"` — staged files are what the gate enumerates reliably.
2. Provide a node/npm runtime (or a plain `node --test` suite declared in `qa_policy.suites`) so `tests/company-active-project.test.mjs` can actually execute.

Re-verification command after (1)+(2): `qa_run_tests(suite="npm", paths=["tests/company-active-project.test.mjs"])` must exit 0, then `qa_review_changes(scope="staged")` must show `mapped_sources >= 2` and `tests_selected >= 1`.

This card's own wake (2026-11-26T11:19Z) is unchanged; the follow-up re-gate is card `9e124b86` (wake 2026-11-26T17:00Z).

## PM shift 37 (2026-11-27T11:05Z) — the commit half of this card is DONE, verified

Measured with `project_changes(scope="all")` this shift: **none of the 5 files of this increment appears in the working tree any more.**

- `src/utils/companyActiveProject.js` → present and tracked; `project_locate("resolveCompanyActiveProject")` resolves it at `src/utils/companyActiveProject.js:38` as a tracked symbol (no longer an untracked file).
- `src/store/project.js`, `src/views/CompanyView.vue`, `src/router/index.ts`, `tests/company-active-project.test.mjs` → no diff against HEAD.
- The current diff is 13 **different** files (navigation consolidation), which proves the tree moved past this increment.

So the increment is in HEAD and the "70 files with no commit path" family of blockers does not apply to it.

**What is still open:** the *demo* of this increment and the QA re-gate (`9e124b86`). Verifying a diff is not demoing behaviour — a company switch that must not leak another company's project has to be shown in the browser, not inferred from a clean `project_changes`.

**Decision:** this card moves to `Review` and its wake is cleared so it stops re-firing; the demo evidence, when it exists, closes it. If the demo has actually already run on another card, point at it here and this closes immediately.
